an5.192:1.1: athakho doṇo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an5.192:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho doṇo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.192:2.2: na samaṇo gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuḍḍhe mahallake addhagate vayoanuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetīti.
an5.192:2.4: na hi bhavaṃ gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuḍḍhe mahallake addhagate vayoanuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti.
an5.192:2.7: yaṃ hi taṃ bho gotama sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an5.192:2.9: mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena ajjhāyiko mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayoti mameva taṃ bho gotama sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an5.192:2.10: ahaṃ hi bho gotama brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto
an5.192:2.11: mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena ajjhāyiko mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayoti
an5.192:3.1: ye kho te doṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isiyo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitamanubhāsanti vācitamanuvācenti seyyathīdaṃ aṭṭhako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamadaggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu
an5.192:3.3: brahmasamaṃ devasamaṃ mariyādaṃ sambhinnamariyādaṃ brāhmaṇacaṇḍālaññeva pañcamaṃ
an5.192:4.1: na kho mayaṃ bho gotama ime pañca brāhmaṇe jānāma athakho mayaṃ brāhmaṇātveva jānāma
an5.192:4.2: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ahaṃ ime pañca brāhmaṇe jāneyyanti.
an5.192:4.3: tenahi doṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti
an5.192:4.4: evaṃ bhoti kho doṇo brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
an5.192:5.2: idha doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:5.3: mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena
an5.192:5.4: so aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno
an5.192:5.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammeneva no adhammena
an5.192:6.2: neva kasiyā na vaṇijjāya na gorakkhena na issatthena na rājaporisena na sippaññatarena kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno
an5.192:6.3: so ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ niyyādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati
an5.192:6.4: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati
an5.192:6.7: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati
an5.192:6.8: so ime cattāro brahmavihāre bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ brahmalokaṃ upapajjati
an5.192:6.9: evaṃ kho doṇa brāhmaṇo brahmasamo hoti.
